parsed.visual_overview: A young man interacts with a CGI robot teacher in a metro train. The ad cuts to a 15-minute graphic and an app pricing screenshot before returning to the train for the final CTA.

scenes.script_native:
Rahul says: Interview में "Myself Rahul" बोल कर intro दे सकता हूँ?
Miss Nova says: (warmly) नहीं Rahul. "Myself" से start करना wrong है. "I am Rahul" या "My name is Rahul" बोलो.
Rahul says: अरे हाँ. पर मुझे English बोलनी नहीं आती.
Miss Nova says: Tension मत लो. मेरे साथ daily...
scenes.script_roman:
Rahul says: Interview mein "Myself Rahul" bol kar intro de sakta hoon?
Miss Nova says: (warmly) Nahi Rahul. "Myself" se start karna wrong hai. "I am Rahul" ya "My name is Rahul" bolo.
Rahul says: Are haan. Par mujhe English bolni nahi aati.
Miss Nova says: Tension mat lo. Mere saath daily...

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: ...सिर्फ 10-15 minutes बोलने की practice करो.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: ...sirf 10-15 minutes bolne ki practice karo.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: मैं सब कुछ Hindi में समझाती हूँ, और सिर्फ 30 days में आप improve करोगे.
Rahul says: Fees ज़्यादा होगी?
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Main sab kuch Hindi mein samjhati hoon, aur sirf 30 days mein aap improve karoge.
Rahul says: Fees zyada hogi?

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: बिल्कुल नहीं, ये offline coaching से सात गुना सस्ता है.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Bilkul nahi, ye offline coaching se saat guna sasta hai.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: 1 crore+ लोग already मेरे साथ practice कर रहे हैं. आज ही Supernova AI download करो.
Rahul says: Super! मैं अभी install करता हूँ.
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: 1 crore+ log already mere saath practice kar rahe hain. Aaj hi Supernova AI download karo.
Rahul says: Super! Main abhi install karta hoon.
